verified_facts.text: The hotel is a few steps from the boat pier.
verified_facts.excerpt: hotel near Lake Como is only a few steps from the boat pier

verified_facts.text: The resort is set in a private park with a swimming pool, solarium and whirlpool area.
verified_facts.excerpt: This unique luxury Lake Como resort is nested in an enchanting private park with swimming pool, solarium and whirlpool area.

verified_facts.text: The park covers over 11,000 square meters of lush green lawns, for sunbathing, jogging or a picnic on the grass.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy the great outdoors in a lush green park of over 11,000 m², where you can sunbathe, go jogging, organize a lunch party, or even a picnic on the grass.

verified_facts.text: Cernobbio is a 10-minute walk from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Cernobbio is just 10 minutes walk from the hotel

verified_facts.text: Como city centre is 10 minutes away by car or by the traditional battello boat.
verified_facts.excerpt: Como city centre is just 10 minutes by car or with the traditional "battello" boat

verified_facts.text: Room windows look out over the private park and pool and the surrounding mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: From the windows of your Lake Como luxury accommodation, you'll have wonderful views of our private park and pool with the surrounding mountain landscape.

verified_facts.text: All rooms are decorated with Made in Italy furniture and have Sheraton signature beds.
verified_facts.excerpt: All rooms are decorated with Made in Italy furniture, free Wi-Fi and Sheraton signature beds.

verified_facts.text: The suites have a separate living room with a dining area.
verified_facts.excerpt: all our suites feature a separate living room with dining area

verified_facts.text: The suites have a private terrace with sun loungers and a coffee table.
verified_facts.excerpt: A private terrace with sun loungers and coffee table complete the features of these wonderful rooms.

verified_facts.text: The Junior Suites open onto the private pool and park.
verified_facts.excerpt: Junior Suites open onto our private pool and park, ideal for your perfect luxury stay on Lake Como

verified_facts.text: The Junior Suite marble bathroom has a double basin, a tub and a separate shower with chromotherapy.
verified_facts.excerpt: The marble bath of the Junior Suite features double basin, tub and a separate shower with chromotherapy for the maximum in relaxation and pampering.

verified_facts.text: Deluxe Terrace rooms have a private terrace with sunbeds and an intimate dining table.
verified_facts.excerpt: Equipped with sunbeds and an intimate dining table, your terrace is ideal to relax and unwind

verified_facts.text: The spa covers over 700 square meters, with treatment rooms, a nail studio and a wet area with an indoor pool, hydropool, sauna, Mediterranean bath, emotional showers and an ice waterfall.
verified_facts.excerpt: A haven of over 700 sqm dedicated to wellbeing with treatment rooms, nail studio and a wet area equipped with an indoor swimming pool, hydropool, sauna, Mediterranean bath, emotional showers and ice waterfall.

verified_facts.text: Spa entry is complimentary for all hotel guests, with reservation required.
verified_facts.excerpt: The entrance is complimentary for all hotel guests. External guests are welcomed at a daily fee. For both reservation is compulsory and subject to availability.

verified_facts.text: Spa rituals are developed with the Italian dermocosmetics brand INSIUM.
verified_facts.excerpt: The rituals are developed in collaboration with the Italian dermocosmetics brand INSÍUM.

verified_facts.text: The spa's Private Suite Experience pairs a couple's massage with exclusive use of the wet area after closing, with fine bubbles and gourmet treats.
verified_facts.excerpt: Indulge in a couple's massage and exclusive use of the wet area in total privacy after the closing hour paired with fine bubbles and gourmet treats.

verified_facts.text: Kitchen is the hotel's Michelin-starred restaurant and opens onto the park.
verified_facts.excerpt: indulge in gourmet cuisine at our intimate Michelin-star restaurant in Lake Como, Kitchen, which opens onto the park.

verified_facts.text: The chef created an organic vegetable garden, Le Luci del Kitchen, in a corner of the park to grow herbs and vegetables for his dishes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our chef Andrea created in a corner of our park a bio vegetable garden to growth herbs and vegetables for his creations.

verified_facts.text: The park has a kids' playground with wooden play equipment.
verified_facts.excerpt: A green area in the park with wooden plays dedicated to all little guests

verified_facts.text: Interconnecting rooms are available for families and groups of friends.
verified_facts.excerpt: Interconnecting rooms are also available to accommodate families and large groups of friends.

verified_facts.text: Dogs get a mat and food and water bowls in the room, plus a special pet menu.
verified_facts.excerpt: we will be happy to provide in your room a comfortable dog mat and a set of bowls for food and water. And for the sweet tooth: a special pet menu!

verified_facts.text: Guests can rent the hotel's electric mopeds to explore Lake Como.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rent now one of our electric mopeds to discover Lake Como in a green way.
